Senior Engineer I Linked in BlueSky Facebook David Kalish is a Senior Engineer I who designs and fabricates devices and parts, develops motion control software, and improves device automation. He is currently the go-to mechanical engineer in the Synthetic Biology Focus Area, where he makes customized tools to aid scientists in their research.
